scope: Competition entry, SDK task loop, context/obligation/knowledge integration, managed local execution and the two competition delivery records; not an exhaustive audit of deferred extensions.
decision: Main path is implemented and reviewable. Four local correctness/reporting issues should close before formal scored experiments; real input and environment preparation can proceed. No runtime rewrite or new method mechanism is required by this review.

findings.trigger: Normally completed graph has no pending work and calls or known tokens exactly exhaust the original budget; resume raises model_budget despite requiring no new execution.
findings.impact: Previously successful completion is downgraded to unresolved by competition reporting.
findings.test_gap: Existing completed-resume integration uses 15 of 40 calls, not the exact limit.
findings.acceptance: Completed reconciliation preserves outcome at exhausted call/token limits with no new requests or checks; pending execution still enforces the original budget and deadline.

findings.trigger: Application stages fail, or stages pass but diagnosis/localization linkage does not satisfy final task acceptance.
findings.impact: Summary can call actual application work not_run or synthetic_checked. Raw stage receipts remain present.
findings.test_gap: Current synthetic outcome and denied application-admission tests do not cover these application summary branches.
findings.acceptance: Validation level and attempted/result state are distinct from final acceptance, retaining application pass/fail/inconclusive/not_run accurately without promoting incomplete tasks.

findings.support: static_conditional_race; no scheduling injection run performed
findings.trigger: The child is resumed after Job assignment but before the manager publishes active.json; manager scheduling is delayed.
findings.impact: A correctly resource-limited worker can be rejected for a missing activity lease. This is not a resource-limit escape.
findings.test_gap: Existing normal startup tests do not deterministically delay publication.
findings.acceptance: Publish the complete activity lease before worker execution; delayed publication, startup failure, stop and cleanup preserve existing protections.

findings.trigger: A completed task is resumed after an idle interval; reporting recomputes now minus original session start.
findings.impact: Completed task timing grows without new solver/check work; review01 first CLI finished roughly 48 seconds after session start and completed-resume report records 185999.626 ms.
findings.test_gap: Existing zero-new-call/check resume assertion does not freeze or compare final execution timing.
findings.acceptance: Freeze terminal task execution timing or separate session elapsed/resume time; do not alter original shared-budget deadline semantics.

claim_evidence: End-to-end software execution has existing synthetic evidence only; it does not establish HarmonyOS repair success.

The demo loads four static resources but reads one; knowledge queries/reads and applicability actions/contexts/reviews are empty. Separate module/SDK tests cover retrieval and applicability, not this demo's usage or transfer effectiveness.
Working context is used at 15 actual model-send sites. Final view increases from 46147 to 66276 bytes (about 43.6%); omitted_ranges are empty. These are bytes, not measured Token savings.

Obligation association and failure-driven reconsideration participate in the demo's two-candidate revision; linkage is optional, and neither citations nor hashes certify business semantic correctness.

DecisionStore restricts capabilities to source/log reading and remaining_probe_budget to zero. Active runtime probes, trusted value capture and default cross-task automatic learning are not delivered competition capabilities.

Effectiveness, localization accuracy, repair rate, savings, learning gains, novelty and publication readiness remain unknown. Compare the existing enhancements under the same model, knowledge, tools and budget before making benefit claims.

evidence_check.note: Counts are selected existing cloud/local/loop/diagnosis/competition tests, not the full repository. Repeated competition runs are not double-counted. Previously passed tests do not validate the newly identified counterexamples. Demo source provenance predates the final missing-first-check metric fix, as already recorded in the product session.

environment: No installations, downloads, cleanup, global configuration, resource-limit changes or source changes. Competition submission templates and original data_B are untouched.
next: One bounded local correctness/reporting closure goal for the four findings with targeted synthetic counterexamples. Preserve optional method mechanisms, resource protections and disabled real-experiment flags; do not expand deferred learning/probe extensions.
